name: State Hope Scale — Snyder original English edition
evidence: Snyder et al. (1996) State Hope Scale, two goal-directed thinking components; six items; a state measure, NOT the 12-item Adult Hope Scale.

name: Children's Hope Scale — original English edition
evidence: Snyder et al. (1997); original six-item, two-component child self-report; NCTSN records Cost: Free and Copyrighted: No.

name: Children's Hope Scale — Portuguese schoolchildren adaptation
evidence: Marques, Pais-Ribeiro, Lopez (2009); Portuguese translation/back-translation and factor, reliability, criterion-validity studies.

name: Children's Hope Scale — Spain adolescent adaptation
evidence: 2019 University of Granada research summary: two-factor CFA with one cross-loading item, Cronbach alpha .76.

name: Children's Hope Scale — Turkish school edition
evidence: Atik and Kemer (2009), validity/reliability study: two-factor support, alpha .74, retest .57.

name: Children's Hope Scale — Mainland Chinese adolescent study
evidence: Ling et al. (2021): Chinese CHS gender invariance; both one- and two-factor models supported.

name: Adult Hope Scale — Russian psychometric translation
evidence: Yelshansky et al. (2014): actual Russian respondent translation and psychometric correlations; alpha .84 for eight scored items; not the state SHS.

name: Herth Hope Index — original adult clinical abbreviated form
evidence: Herth (1992): 12-item adaptation of longer HHS, original three-factor model; reliability and validity examined.

name: Herth Hope Index — Brazilian Portuguese clinical version
evidence: Sartore & Grossi (2008), 131 respondents; translated and validated 12-item four-response Portuguese version.

name: Herth Hope Index — Spanish post-suicide-attempt clinical model
evidence: Sánchez-Teruel et al. (2020), Psychiatric Quarterly: two-dimensional Spanish clinical adaptation, alpha .97.

name: Herth Hope Index — Spain general-population 9-item factor solution
evidence: Robles-Bello & Sánchez-Teruel (2022 online; 2023 issue): one-factor 9-item form after removal of original items 3,5,6; sex configural invariance, age scalar invariance NOT established.

name: Herth Hope Index — Spanish oncology 12-item one-factor study
evidence: Calderon et al. (2024), Psicothema: one-factor model, omega .88; invariance by sex, age, tumor site and expected survival.

name: Herth Hope Index — Swiss French validated HHI-F
evidence: Gronier et al. (2023): French translation/back-translation and validation; two-factor best fit, some cross-loadings, original three-factor model not reproduced.

name: Herth Hope Index — Italian oncology validated edition
evidence: Ripamonti et al. (2012): Italian translation and oncology CFA; one-factor model preferred, original three-factor unsupported.

name: Herth Hope Index — German oncology HHI-D edition
evidence: Geiser et al. (2015): authorized German translation and validation; study recommends using only HHI-D total score.

name: Herth Hope Index — Hong Kong Chinese heart-failure adaptation
evidence: Chan, Li, Chan, Lopez (2012): new Chinese respondent translation; reliability/content/construct validation and test–retest.

name: Herth Hope Index — Kinyarwanda adapted oral/visual format
evidence: Ishimwe et al. (2020) with Kaye Herth: Kinyarwanda language and oral administration with cup-response visuals; original 3-factor CFA adequate.

name: Hunter Opinions and Personal Expectations Scale — revised 20-item form
evidence: Nunn et al. (1996) Psychological Medicine: initial forms refined to 20-item, two-factor trait questionnaire; 20-item form independently listed by McGill MAP-PRO.
